settings.question: How does it connect and power on?
settings.answer: It's USB powered — just plug it into any phone charger, laptop, or power bank with the included cable. Control it with the included remote or the free app (iOS & Android).

settings.question: How fast is shipping?
settings.answer: Free tracked shipping on every order. Most orders arrive in 2–3 business days, and you'll get a tracking link by email the moment it ships.

settings.question: Is it quiet enough to sleep with?
settings.answer: Yes. The motor runs under 25dB — quieter than a whisper. There's also a static (no-rotation) mode and a sleep timer.

settings.question: What if I don't love it?
settings.answer: You're covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If it's not your vibe, send it back for a full refund.

settings.question: How big a room can it fill?
settings.answer: It comfortably covers rooms up to ~430 sq ft (40 m²) — bedrooms, dorms, living rooms and ceilings. Tilt the head to aim it.

settings.question: Is the Buy 1 Get 1 50% off deal real?
settings.answer: Yep — add 2 to your cart and the second is automatically 50% off. Most people grab a second as a gift.
